messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T07:23Z failing in region us-west-2. 12% of requests hitting service-returning decrypt errors for secrets path /secrets/new-config. Error: AccessDeniedException from KMS.
jamie: paging @cheng — oncall, can you take? errors spiking for the canary, customer impact small but growing.
cheng: on it. which deploy? canary tag: canary-2026-03-17-7
jamie: payload log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T07:22:45Z ERROR secrets/loader.go:142 decrypt: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/redwood-canary/Lambda is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-NEWKEY
```
cheng: ok looks like rotated key id. Did rollout include KMS alias swap? @sophia any notes from deploy team?
sophia: we rotated the secret and created new key alias alias/redwood-secrets-v2 as part of release. We added key metadata to config but forgot to update the canary IAM policy to include kms:Decrypt on the new key id.
oliver: can we flip the feature flag to fallback to old secret path? ff/secret_mux -> off for canary only.
jamie: trying flag flip now.
jamie: /rollout-flag ff/secret_mux canary-2026-03-17 false --scope=canary
oncall-bot: action accepted: ff/secret_mux set to false for canary-2026-03-17 by jamie
jamie: quick check: error rate down to 1.3% from 12% for canary traffic :thumbsup: 
cheng: good quick mitigation. we still need fix to allow decrypt or avoid future rotations causing this. I'll patch the canary role to include the new key id for now.
cheng: running:
```
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name redwood-canary --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::111:policy/RedwoodKmsDecryptNewKey
# OR inline update to statement adding \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-NEWKEY\"
```
cheng: IAM change applied, propagating.
jamie: canary retrying rollout step to validate decrypt now.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: canary group replay triggered by jamie
cheng: logs now show successful decrypts:
```
2026-03-17T07:29:03Z INFO secrets/loader.go:146 decrypt: success key=abcd-NEWKEY
```
oliver: nice. plan: keep feature flag off and patch IAM in prod groups, then fully resume rollout after verification. Also schedule a short rollback window if anything else pops.
sophia: agree. I'll coordinate with release lead to pause main rollout and inventory all places where KMS alias swap happened.
jamie: I'll open a quick incident ticket and annotate customer-facing impact: small fraction of requests for canary users in us-west-2 returned 5xx due to secret decrypt. No major customers reported, CS notified.
cheng: handing off to @oliver for overnight monitoring and follow-up remediation tasks (update runbook, ensure key rotation checklist includes IAM updates). please take pager duty.
oliver: taking it. I'll keep flag off and monitor for 2h, then if stable resume incremental rollout with canary included.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by oliver. Incident ID PD-20260317-22
jamie: postmortem required — root cause: KMS key alias rotation without corresponding IAM policy update for canary role; mitigation included feature-flag kill-switch + IAM policy patch + temporary rollback pause. Assign to release + infra teams.
oliver: noted. creating follow-up: task: update runbook and add automation to validate IAM permissions when rotating keys. ETA EOD tomorrow.
cheng: any objections to closing this oncall thread after handoff? I'll remain reachable if anything else shows up.
jamie: all good from me. thanks team :heart:
